auto_update.comment: Weekly auto-update toggle. Flip 'enabled' with: make weekly-on / make weekly-off. The scheduled runner checks this file each week and stays silent while enabled=false.

policy.comment: refresh_gleif: re-pull the GLEIF CH slice each update (new LEIs appear weekly). refresh_static_archives: only used by --refresh-all; static research archives (TabFormer, IEEE-CIS, ULB, ...) are otherwise cached forever.
